# Product notes

A calm reading surface for structured Markdown documents.

## Reading mode

Reading mode renders Markdown without editable syntax and keeps the document centered.

> The document stays primary while controls remain within reach.

### Semantic sections

Every heading defines a section that can be copied with one action.

- Parent sections include their nested subsections.
- Copy controls appear only in reading mode.

## Theme controls

| Setting | Options |
| --- | --- |
| Theme | Light, dark, system |
| Typography | Serif, system, monospace |
| Layout | Text size, line height, width |

```js
const mode = 'read';
```
